title: Obstacle Avoidance
text: Compute obstacle-free direction using range sensor data and target position, 4 inputs, 3 outputs; {Sensor range limits (m)} sets the limits of range sensor, {Sensor horizontal field of view (deg)} sets the horizontal field of view limits of range sensor, {Sensor vertical field of view (deg)} sets the vertical field of view limits of range sensor, {Sensor location [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the sensor mounting location on UAV, {Sensor orientation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the orientation of sensor mounted on UAV, {Vehicle radius (m)} sets the radius of UAV, {Minimum distance to obstacle (m)} sets the safety distance around UAV to obstacle, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Histogram resolution (deg)} sets the histogram grid resolution, {Histogram window size}, {Histogram threshold} sets the threshold for computing histogram, {Maximum age of obstacle point} sets the maximum age of remembered obstacle point, {Target direction weight} sets the cost function weight for target direction, {Current direction weight} sets the cost function weight for current direction and {Previous direction weight} sets the cost function weight for previous. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sensor range limits (m)
params.values: Limits of range sensor [0.2 10] (default) | vector of form [ min max ]

params.name: Sensor horizontal field of view (deg)
params.values: Horizontal field of view limits of range sensor [-60 60] (default) | vector of form [ min max ]

params.name: Sensor vertical field of view (deg)
params.values: Vertical field of view limits of range sensor [-30 30] (default) | vector of form [ min max ]

params.name: Sensor location [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: Sensor mounting location on UAV [0 0 0] (default) | vector of form [ x y z ]

params.name: Sensor orientation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: Orientation of sensor mounted on UAV [0 0 0] (default) | vector of form [ roll pitch yaw ]

params.name: Minimum distance to obstacle (m)
params.values: Safety distance around UAV to obstacle 1 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Histogram threshold
params.values: Threshold for computing histogram 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Maximum age of obstacle point
params.values: Maximum age of remembered obstacle point 0 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Target direction weight
params.values: Cost function weight for target direction 5 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Current direction weight
params.values: Cost function weight for current direction 2 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: Previous direction weight
params.values: Cost function weight for previous direction 2 (default) | numeric scalar
